firstDelivery.description: M0/M1 minimum kernel with read-only execution projection; original checkpoint results retained in backend.

added: Registered deterministic candidate generator and injectable LLM proposal adapter, immutable idempotent candidates, compiler-authoritative save and fake-LLM malicious proposal rejection; no live planner provider auto-wiring.

Structural draft UI for versioned nodes, typed fixed-version/upstream port bindings, list sources, control edges and budget; saved plan approval/activation/revocation, design-version approval and human-output submission use backend version/digest checks.
Engine to LegacyJsonDispatcher to LlmAgents mock-provider proof of exact inputs, execution address, roles, context and live revocation guards; synthetic fixtures are clearly labelled.

Local controlled primitive executor wired into Engine serial runtime: durable job intent/key/digest, sequenced events, cancellation request, result export/hash, unknown recovery and explicit unsupported cross-process resume.

Per-role Skill resolver with transitive locking, exact/caret constraints, cycle/conflict rejection, parameter scope/allowlist checks, required/optional obligations, three-value applicability, capability and live revocation checks; existing instruction skills feed actual requests.

ContextBuilder fixed-version projection and provenance manifest, required-input overflow rejection, optional omission trace, final request budget check, live authority recheck before every primitive/read/model call and immediately before HTTP send.
Artifact approvals now bind the whole immutable version envelope including provenance and base SHA, rather than content alone; final result publication revalidates input approvals.
SSE context-close drains and completes streams before graceful web-server shutdown; the leaking test input stream is now closed. No timeout override or test disable was used.

Conservative priced-model/fallback/retry budget preflight; reported failed provider usage remains charged. New tables have forced PostgreSQL RLS, composite scope FKs and immutable event/manifest/revocation tests.
stillMissing: No selected real CodingExecutor harness, arbitrary project commands, real coding tool loop, browser runner, real PR/CI/delivery or deployment integration.
Local primitive adapter is an in-process controlled file test implementation, not OS isolation for arbitrary untrusted code; projectTestExecution=false and businessValidation=UNKNOWN.
Cross-process resume is explicitly unsupported; no real runner submit-response-loss/termination/takeover test or outbound GitHub write fencing proxy.
Skill v2 published package/fixture pipeline, dependency parameter mappings, general semver grammar, global multi-scope configuration UI and executable capability packs remain partial.
ContextBuilder uses conservative byte-based token estimates and fixed caps; no full retrieval/compression/ProjectKnowledge loop or large-artifact object storage lifecycle.
Editor material import and human output still use JSON fields; structured node/binding forms exist, but complete guided role/Skill/condition forms and browser interaction acceptance are not done.
Schema 3 task creation has an opt-in API, not a complete guided task creation experience. Admission and local executor stay disabled by default.
Only contract/adapter fixtures cover frontend/backend/fullstack scenarios; real end-to-end M0/M1/M2 exit gates remain NOT_EXECUTED under the explicit external-effect restriction.

implementationChoices: Conditional input facts must be backed by the pinned scopeEvidence version. UNKNOWN produces a blocking compiler diagnostic; dynamic choice/join and parallel admission remain deferred.
The default planner is a registered deterministic proposal source; an LLM adapter exists for explicit injection and is tested with a fake provider. No live planner/model expense is enabled.
The local executor uses only closed primitive file actions and built-in assertions in owned empty temporary directories. It cannot run arbitrary scripts and is not advertised as an OS sandbox.

Artifact input approval now covers exact immutable identity and provenance plus base SHA. The minimal envelope lacks a separate committed head SHA; real code/test attestation remains future runner work.
Skill constraints initially support exact numeric or caret versions, not arbitrary semver/ranges. Unsupported or conflicting inputs fail explicitly rather than selecting latest.
Expand-only migrations V22–V30 preserve existing V1–V21 and legacy evidence. Earlier unverified instructions remain INSTRUCTION-only and cannot mint validation PASS.
